transcript: Have you ever wondered why a cat disappears without warning and without a trace? Most people think it ran away or got lost. But its absence hides a deeper truth. Cats are not just silent and mysterious. They are guardians of the invisible. They perceive energies that we cannot even begin to understand. When a cat enters your life, it is not by chance it chooses you. And while it stays, it absorbs your burdens, blocks invisible harm, and protects you from a darkness that could have destroyed you from within. In our monastery, we have always observed this. Cats arrive when they are needed and leave when they are done. When a cat suddenly disappears, it is not abandonment. It is a farewell. After completing its mission, your cat carried away a heavy energy that was near you, a shadow you did not even know existed. And the most powerful part is that many times the darkness does not come back because your cat did not just feel it, it fought it, carried it, and drove it away. If a cat disappeared from your life for no reason, do not see it as a loss. It is a final act of silent love because perhaps that cat saved your life. Write gratitude in the comments if a cat passed through your life and left. But I want you to understand something. Your cat took away what was threatening you. But if stress, fear, and emotions you are not releasing still live inside you, new darkness will accumulate. There will not always be a guardian to carry that weight for you. The day you learn to release what is heavy on your own, you no longer need anyone else to carry it. Your cat protected you for as long as it could. Now it is your turn to learn to protect yourself from within. And if you want to build that inner protection that depends on no one, I've spent more than 20 years learning in silence how to do it. And everything I know is inside the path back to calm. The link is in my profile.
